```plato

    //==
    // # Derived functionality for mesh connectivity
    //
    // Pure, expression-bodied helpers for the interfaces declared in
    // `topology.concepts.plato` (IMeshElementCounts, IMeshIncidence,
    // IHalfEdge). Part of P8 of the interface library.
    //
    // The three sections follow the interface ladder: what counts alone can tell you,
    // what incidence adds, and what a built half-edge structure adds. Each helper
    // sits on the weakest rung that can answer it — the valence of a vertex needs
    // incidence but not half-edges, so it is written once, there.
    //
    // Lower-package generics are reused, not re-declared: Integer counts are `IWhole`,
    // so P1's `IsZero`/`IsPositive`/`IsNegative` apply directly; typed element
    // indices are `IIndex`, so P2's `IsNone`/`IsPresent` express "-1 means none"
    // without touching `.Value`.

    //==
    // IMeshElementCounts — counted mesh elements: vertices, undirected edges,
    // faces. All derived facts follow from the three counts and the Euler
    // relation. Nothing here can see connectivity, so nothing here can check
    // the closed/connected/manifold preconditions its formulas need.

    // The Euler characteristic V - E + F
    // (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Euler_characteristic). A closed connected
    // manifold of genus g has Euler characteristic 2 - 2g; a disk has 1, a sphere
    // 2, a torus 0.
    EulerCharacteristic(self: IMeshElementCounts): Integer
        => self.VertexCount - self.UndirectedEdgeCount + self.FaceCount;
```
